newsitem.title: USA: Corrections stake held by Zweig-DiMenna.
newsitem.headline: Corrections stake held by Zweig-DiMenna.

text.p: A group led by Zweig-DiMenna Associates LLC said Monday it holds a 5.2 percent stake in Corrections Corp of America or 3,917,000 common shares.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said its latest transactions include a net 215,700 common shares bought between Dec 17, 1966, and Feb 20 at $27.795 to $33.8393 per share.
Corrections, based in Nashville, Tenn., provides corrections services to governmental agencies, including managing, financing, designing and constructing new corrections jails and prisons.
